top_signals.title: ‘Heck of an earnings call’:  Nvidia crunch results could weigh on Anthropic IPO
top_signals.summary: Nvidia’s crunch earnings update on Tuesday could cloud the outlook for Anthropic’s blockbuster IPO later this week, analysts have warned. top_signals.title: Democrats Target Trump’s $100 Billion Venezuela Oil Deal
top_signals.summary: Congressional Democrats are preparing multiple investigations into President Donald Trump's $100 billion Venezuela oil agreement, with plans to subpoena administration officials over a deal that handed a little-known private company rights to 17 Venezuelan oilfields. The August agreement gives Alejandro Betancourt's North American Blue Energy Partners (NABEP) 100-year concessions covering fields with an estimated 65 billion barrels of reserves. Washington receives a 35% equity stake in the company and the right to purchase 20% of its oil production…
